goal: Keep finished private broadcast transactions in memory and expose them in getprivatebroadcastinfo
Gives node operators visibility into send history, peer acknowledgments, and network echo details
agreement: Concept approval because completed transaction info is useful to operators (optout21)
Verified fixes for retry exhaustion and peer overwrite logic (frankomosh)
Suggests retaining the received flag upon re-request if already in mempool (optout21)
Suggests adding a test verifying received_by_us is not overwritten (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it improves visibility into private broadcasts without altering core relay protocols
Benefit is limited to node operators inspecting local private broadcast send history
